entries.title: Dear Google, Apple, Mozilla, and MS: Please End Auto-Playing Media in Browsers
entries.author: geuis
entries.current_title: Dear Google, Apple, Mozilla, and MS: Please End Auto-Playing Media in Browsers
entries.excerpt: I know there are plugins than can somewhat do this, but no solutions are universal or great. Please update all of our browsers so that no automatic video/audio can play without user interaction/permission. Its getting to be impossible to visit many sites today without being bombarded by video and sound playing by default on the web. In the worst cases such as on mobile browsers like iOS Safari, visiting a site will start playing media that kills whatever you're already listen
entries.guide_zh: 发帖者呼吁主要浏览器厂商停止默认自动播放音频与视频。

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is firing?
entries.author: wellworld
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Who is firing?
entries.excerpt: The startup I work at will soon be undergoing an exodus of staff due to a failure in leadership and management by the founders. Really painful, sad, situation for all involved. So, I figure if we're allowed to talk about who is hiring, why not the other way around? At the very least, we can get a pulse on those companies which smells like roses on the outside, and reek of something more earthy on the inside.
entries.guide_zh: 经历公司管理失误后，发帖者邀请社区讨论哪些公司正在裁员或流失员工。
